# SaveShare.io

> Sourced UK personal-finance creator directory with attributed net-worth
> figures and stats. Free for humans browsing. Bulk/agent/API access
> requires a licence — see https://saveshare.io/licensing.html

## Allowed
- Human browsing and linking
- Short quotations with attribution + link back

## Not allowed without a licence
- Bulk scraping of creator profiles, figures, or stats
- Dataset construction or model training on site content
- Automated agents polling pages at scale

## Contact
licensing@saveshare.io
